value.rationale: The graph H(3,3) is a canonical symmetric three-factor ternary Hamming graph; ordinary four-cut is the first connectivity threshold after its extensively studied three-cut stage. Exact dual integral homotopy and two nontrivial free original homology degrees give a complete finite classification and substantive lower-dimensional nonshellability obstruction, not a routine deduction from the earlier k=3 formula. Its full finite face/cell certificate supports reuse in cut-topology and equivariant investigations without pretending to solve a general family.
